brief.Text: The peninsula still has a count for you. Cull four Numb Eremites, four Brisk Dryads, and four Malah-Dor, then return.

progress.Text: Eremites, Brisk Dryads, and Malah-Dor. Then we will speak of the tower.

turnin.Text: The count is enough. Tower Keeper Tagnat is near the Vortex. Mourning Calamity Five waits at 1925 by 1108. {completequest AO37}

after.Text: Tagnat, then Mourning Calamity Five at the Vortex.
